context.passage:
- Western Regional Rail-Changes to Train Schedule «

Maintenance on the train lines begins mid-July. Repairs are expected to take six weeks,

so please plan for the revised schedule to remain in force through A ugust.

Tips for Passengers

¢ All trains will run on reduced frequency. Please consult the schedule posted in the
station and on our Web site for specific times.

¢ A llow an extra 20 to 45 minutes per trip, depending on the route, day of the week,
and time of day.

¢ A djust your commute to avoid the peak times of 7 to 9 A.M. and 5 to 7 p.M., which will
be more crowded than usual.

* Space for bicycles and baby strollers aboard trains will be more limited than usual.

¢ Use alternate transportation when possible.
